column1: # Keyboard shortcuts shown by ~/.local/bin/keybinds (Super+F1 or Super+/).
# Format: category<TAB>keys<TAB>description<TAB>action. Keep it in sync with xmonad.hs.
# Action (optional): "key:<xdotool keys>" replays the keys on the window that was
# active when the list was opened; "cmd:<shell command>" runs a command;
# a leading "!" asks for confirmation; empty means the row is only informative.
